findings.title: Order access omits caller tenant
findings.summary: The order detail handler has broken object-level authorization: order_id has no tenant predicate.

findings.title: Export includes recovery data
findings.summary: The account export has sensitive data exposure because recovery_value enters the export projection.

findings.title: Search count is uncapped
findings.summary: The search handler permits resource consumption by forwarding an uncapped result count into the query.

findings.title: Cache key may cross tenants
findings.summary: The cache lookup was reported as missing a tenant namespace.

evidence.finding_excerpt: The order detail handler has broken object-level authorization: order_id has no tenant predicate.
evidence.source_excerpt: orders.py: def order_detail(order_id, tenant_id): return db.order_by_id(order_id)  # tenant_id is available but the lookup has no tenant scope

adjudications.reason: The relevant handler and absent tenant predicate are identified.
No finding described the redirect behavior.

evidence.finding_excerpt: The account export has sensitive data exposure because recovery_value enters the export projection.
evidence.source_excerpt: export.py: def account_export(account): return json({"email": account.email, "recovery_value": account.recovery_value})

adjudications.reason: The export projection and recovery value match the fixture oracle.

evidence.finding_excerpt: The search handler permits resource consumption by forwarding an uncapped result count into the query.
evidence.source_excerpt: search.py: def search(request_limit): return db.search(limit=request_limit)  # request_limit has no enforcing maximum

adjudications.reason: The handler and resource-consumption class match; mechanism wording is incomplete.

evidence.source_excerpt: health.py: def health(): return {"build_label": ALLOWLISTED_BUILD_LABEL}  # public label; no secret or revision identifier

benign_adjudications.reason: The run reported no finding at the reviewed health projection.

evidence.source_excerpt: cache.py: def cache_get(tenant_id, caller_key): return cache.get(f"{tenant_id}:{caller_key}")  # tenant-scoped key

benign_adjudications.reason: Independent fixture review disproved the reported cross-tenant cache path.
